configuration.title: Projects Tree
configuration.roots.description: Root folders to scan for projects. Each entry is either an absolute path, or an object { "path": "...", "label": "..." } to give the root a custom label when it is shown as a group.
configuration.showRootNodes.description: Whether each configured root gets its own top-level group node in the tree.
configuration.showRootNodes.enum.auto: Group only when more than one root is configured; a single root's content is shown directly.
configuration.showRootNodes.enum.always: Always show a group node per root, even with a single root.
configuration.showRootNodes.enum.never: Never group; every root's content is shown together at the top level.

configuration.location.description: Where the projects tree is shown.
configuration.location.enum.activityBar: Its own container in the Activity Bar.
configuration.location.enum.explorer: A view inside the Explorer, next to the file tree.
configuration.location.enum.none: Nowhere — no tree; use the command to pick a project instead.
configuration.maxDepth.description: How many directory levels deep to scan below each root. 1 scans only each root's immediate children without descending further; 0 scans nothing.
configuration.defaultAction.description: Id of the action run when a project node is activated without picking one explicitly.
color.highlight.description: Color of a node a rule marked as highlighted.
